questions.stem: What is the smallest number of bits that can store every unsigned integer from 0 to 100?
questions.explain: 6 bits reach only 63, but 7 bits reach 127, which covers 100.

questions.stem: Which statement is equivalent to “if p then q”?
questions.explain: “If p then q” is false only when p is true and q is false, and ¬p ∨ q is false in exactly that case.
